title: Shared values
learning_outcomes: Explain values versus preferences in the context of shared values.
Compare and distinguish joint priorities in the context of shared values.
Apply mutually acceptable options in the context of shared values.
Evaluate and justify decisions about reviews in the context of shared values.

lessons.title: Values versus preferences
lessons.outcome: Explain values versus preferences in the context of shared values.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving values versus preferences; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to shared decision exercise.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain values versus preferences from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of values versus preferences; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Joint priorities
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish joint priorities in the context of shared values.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving joint priorities; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to shared decision exercise.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain joint priorities from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of joint priorities; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Mutually acceptable options
lessons.outcome: Apply mutually acceptable options in the context of shared values.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving mutually acceptable options; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to shared decision exercise.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain mutually acceptable options from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of mutually acceptable options; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Reviews
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about reviews in the context of shared values.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving reviews; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to shared decision exercise.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain reviews from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of reviews; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of values versus preferences; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of joint priorities; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of mutually acceptable options; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of reviews; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
